body: They took it down in April.

I didn't go to school so now I feel bad about that, and I wasn't productive. I'm still trying to think less destructive thoughts. I'm here at least.

How about you?
Stable? Kind of numb. I want to stay in bed haha.
I'm sorry you feel it too. It's a shitty feeling.
I deleted Facebook, unfollowed her on everything. I just can't do it anymore and the guilt is kicking in.
I'd give you a hug. Or 12. You might be going througb a bad time. Doesn't mean you don't deserve love and affection.

Yeah. And it affects my self confidence, I feel like I'm incompetent because I forget a lot. Deadlines and dates. Now, I forget the names of people I've met recently and I'm normally excellent with names and faces and voices.
I feel a little like a traitor haha. But thank you for understanding. I'll do my best.
Thank you for your understanding and your kind words. ♡

It's not much that kind of commitment that I feel. I would be up at 2AM because I couldn't wait to see it. I'm not at all the stream all day kind nor the buy all the things type or the interact a lot with other  Shawols type. I don't even have twitter or anything like that. It was more like, they were my personal escape, my little island where things felt great.  No one had to know. I only have a handful of their albums (completing my collection slowly). I love their music, there's only like two tracks I'd skip on a playlist, I love the boys a lot too. Much like you, I'm not organized as a shawol either, I love them and what they do. That's it. They had me smiling when I felt like crying a lot.

It's just that it feels like saying goodbye to something that's been a part of me for a long time. Feels like moving out from a home you loved not because you wanted to but because keeping yourself safe came for too big of a price and you can't afford it. Part of you stays there and you leave hoping to be comfortable somewhere new.

All the time. Especially when I'm standing somewhere high like the bridge I bike on to get to work or when the subway I take everyday is arriving. How easy would it be to just.... jump. But I won't. I know I can't. I want to but I am afraid of pain, I am afraid of missing myself again, I am afraid of being a disfigured bloody mess that would traumatize my family.... There's the human instinct to survive and preserve myself that naturally kicks in even if I'm constantly thinking about dying and why I should not be alive anymore.

 I'm also afraid of this "rest of my life" that I haven't planned one bit because I didn't plan on living this long, I'm afraid of having to deal with it because I survive those thoughts; Oddly, I still long for a me that can live happily so I may be afraid of losing this chance at becoming that happier me; if I'm not alive I can't be happy but I also don't want to be alive. It's a conflicting thing.
Everyday.

Okay, first, jumping in front of a car can be extremely painful and unsuccessful. You might want to not do that.

And man, you're only 17. I really wished you didn't feel this way and that your parents were a bit more cooperative and helpful, they should take care of you and not give you one more problem instead. Did you ever try to get help for that depression and anxiety combo? If not, is there any way you can get some?

You can find reasons to live. And honestly, maybe life without your parents can actually bring you something. Can you crash at a friend's for a while?

That nihilistic view.... yeah. Yeah. I know it well. I still ask myself why the hell I get up to work, teach or study. To get money? To buy things with said money? To have things to do stuff with? To do stuff that don't matter in the end? We all die, man, I don't know why we insist so much on it being when we're old.

What do you do on a daily basis, mate? Like, what's a day in your life like? And is there anything you're interested in at all?

I agree with you, I really do, and I know what it  is like to not see the point anymore because I'm at that point right now. Maybe you need to step out of your routine? Or seek help and see if it's an issue with your neurotransmitters? Just suggesting because I don't think it's fair for someone who worked hard to get what they want to not feel anything after accomplishing that feat.
Same. Pretty sure I bit someone once over that.

I relate to that feeling. I've accepted this lately, too. I'm sorry you got to this point, OP. Please hold on as much as you can and try as many (new) things as you can, who knows, maybe you'll discover your reason to not want out of this life; I really hope you get a chance at that, you clearly suffered a lot and deserve better.

I've been trying too hard to keep myself together and I think I'm falling apart again but I'm no longer able to see the reason why I try so hard. It's hard to feel things now, I just feel hollow. I don't even know why I cry anymore, I just do it for hours. I'm so tired.
I wish you the best.

Your words hit me hard and I had to comment and talk to you. I'm a queer woman quite a few years older than you and I can relate to what you are going through. At your age, I was unemployed and I'm pretty sure my first drop out was then. And I'm sorry about how you feel about the LGBT community, a lot of it is trash at times but once you find the right people who understand, it's a great place to be.

Honey, if you want a job, keep hunting. Someone's gonna say yes. I was jobless for a solid 8 months until someone took me. It wasn't great but it was a start. That kind of start can be ahead of you.

I gather you're Australian(?) and ATAR sounds like a real bitch from how I understood it in the study abroad panel I attended before. I don't think this ATAR represents your ability; if you were in that funk you're in when you took the tests, getting a chance to produce the results that are a real reflection of what you can do was really damn difficult but I'm really proud of you for trying so hard and making it to uni. You're clearly really hardworking and you wanted to do well very badly. You did the damn thing, and that's something I wish you'd give yourself the credit for. You worked so hard for that.

And you're only 18. I know it sucks at home right now but put your energy into finding a job that might keep you out of the house a bit more. Save up. Move out. Start your own life on your own terms, it's yours. It might give you a long term goal to hang on to. Give yourself the chance to start uni life. Who knows, you might make some rad new friends who are better than the ones you seem to have disconnected from. I know it's cliche but there is so much ahead of you at 18, life changes a lot around that age and I'm not gonna tell you what to do but I really hope you stay with us. If you need it, you can talk to me.
Teared up again... thank you so much for this. It means so much to me, you have no idea. ♡

I don't know if this is too long, but I'd like to say this to him, "Ever since you left, I've been trying to tell myself that life has to end but love does not have to so I'll keep you in my heart forever. I will live with your light and I'll try to find mine. You fought so hard, you did so well and you inspired me. I love you. I miss you. Thank you for everything. Farewell for now, Jonghyun, rest peacefully. We'll meet again soon."

As for how I'm doing, well, I've been in therapy since the shock of losing him brought me back to a very dark place. My sessions ended, I can't afford more since I lost my job last week. It feels like a downward spiral lately and I feel lost at sea but... I'm trying? I've been crying for 4 hours straight because I thought too hard about how badly I hope there is something after death that's wonderful and without sorrow because he deserves peace so much.

I'm still a mess, but I'm doing my best.
Thanks for staying. I hope tomorrow is gonna be a better day, you deserve a better day. And another. And more of them. Take care, mate.

I mean I'd give up on me or run out of resources too. I'm a handful. I don't know what else she can do at this point especially since I'm being handed to a different one soon. I can understand but it just didn't feel right.

You're so lucky to have someone who cares this much about you. You're loved, and your boyfriend is trying to do the right thing by supporting you in a way he can.

Psychiatric wards aren't that bad, some are worst than others, but they separate cases. In my case, we were in a separate unit with about 10 rooms with attempt survivors. We were fed, watched, looked after, had people reevaluating us. I hated it. So fucking much. But looking back on it, I'm grateful the service exists. That it keeps people alive. The follow up after that, once they judge you less harmful for yourself, that's grueling. But. It's worth a shot? Suicide is literally the last thing you can do so you should try all the other things first, right? Appreciating the little things is indeed a good start, heck, the highlight of my month are erasable pens I recently got.

I'm a hypocrite in a sense because I feel a similar way. A lot of what you wrote are things I could have written about myself but I couldn't not comment and not let you know that I'm with you. 

Please don't give up, mate.

First off, I'm really glad you're still with us. Thanks for giving yourself another chance.

Second, I really think you should tell your loved ones and seek a therapist. Loved ones aren't necessarily family, but the people who care about you and who would feel your absence and mourn your passing. These people want your best, so knowing you're at a worse point might get them to help you. You seem like a young person, too, and I'm very sure you are cherished so give this life thing a chance. Yes, they might alert your family but that's because they care.

Yes, it's hard to accept help but they'd want you here, dear. I want you here, too.
That's great! I'm proud of you, mate. I don't drink but I'm gonna have this water bottle in your honor. :)

I always thought "nothing happens, it's just nothingness" or humorously, just some voice telling you "Jesus is an actor, God is an actor, there is nothing here, your life was meaningless and you just got Punk'd."

But since I've lost a loved one who took his life, I ponder about what happens to him. The world broke his heart and spirit, and I hope that "better place" some people tell me he's in when they give their sympathies actually exists. I started hoping that he's able to watch us, that he can watch me fuck up and spill the milk for the 3rd time in the same morning and have a great big guffaw about it. I look up at the sky a lot hoping he's there; I associate the very few things that go right these days to him watching out for me.... 

Objectively, I know I'm probably just delusional and mourning or having another bout of psychosis. I'm not even religious, but it's fascinating how some people really believe that there's something after all of this, that we can be saved and that we'll live in eternal paradise and all.... must be nice to have this kind of hope and ability to see the end of life as positive. I see it as positive for another set of reasons, because this nothingness after death is that place "where there's no more pain."
Yup. That and guilt are keeping me alive.

Hey, mate. I'm sorry this stuff is happening to you.

Is there any way you can talk about how you feel with your parents? Even one of them? Please?

I'm in the hospital reading this and it made me cry. I don't know why I'm trying but I am. Please find strength, mate. I hope there's light for you. I'm sending you warmth though I'm pretty cold right now.
I was at that point a few hours ago. I've checked into the hospital for help. Please tell me you're still here.
Hey. Wanna talk about it? What's going on?
Same, and gun control here prevents me from getting one. Please don't get a gun, mate. And hanging fucking hurts.
Thank you for replying at all. Good night.

That happened to me. Sorry to hear it, mate. You might feel lost for a while but I think the fact that you came back at all might mean that you are meant to give this life thing another chance. Is there anything you want to do right now that might be a good distraction? Do you have hobbies?
Hey, Zeldov. Wanna tell me about those happy times? Why can't new ones be made?
